name: @banwonpoker/server

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/server.mjs --external:bufferutil --external:utf-8-validate "--banner:js=import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
